windowRaise.target: the scratch instance launched by this harness (browser pid from CDP SystemInfo.getProcessInfo on the harness CDP port)
windowRaise.call: tools/measure-layout.mjs psWindow(pid, "raise") -> user32!SetWindowPos(hwnd, HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW | SWP_NOACTIVATE)
windowRaise.note: An unraised/occluded Chromium window does not advance CSS animations (a minimized window stops producing frames entirely; docs/dev/zcode-dom-notes.md), so an app-side toast can sit frozen below the fold and look like a persistent clip. The sweep (tools/measure-layout.mjs) raises its scratch window before measuring; this raise aligns the harness measurement conditions with the sweep. A failed raise is recorded here and does not fail the run on its own.
